sources.title: Keural Nova v1.2 — NVFP4 quantization - GitHub
sources.snippet: Two NVFP4 (4-bit) quantizations of Keural Nova v1.2 for NVIDIA Blackwell + vLLM. Both are compressed-tensors (vLLM-native), produced with llm-compressor, keeping the vision tower + MTP (and, for unsloth, the linear-attention + router gates) in higher precision.
